claims.statement: KIT reports a prototype combining a transparent silica/PDMS PDRC layer, Fresnel concentration and a photovoltaic-thermal collector for simultaneous cooling, electricity and heat.
KIT reports outdoor results of up to 6.5 degrees Celsius below ambient, 60.6 watts per square meter electrical power density and heat up to 110.8 degrees Celsius.
claims.scope: Institutional report and publication abstract; this audit did not independently reproduce the experiment.

claims.statement: The broad KIT research direction combining photovoltaics, solar thermal energy and radiative cooling was publicly described by KIT no later than the page state marked 2023-05-08.
The Standard Thermal patent record describes resistance heaters in earthen thermal storage and later heat extraction.
The Standard Thermal patent family lists a priority date of 2024-03-03, before the bound Juri August 2026 artifacts.
claims.scope: Patent-record chronology only; no opinion on validity, ownership or infringement.

claims.statement: The Juri model and KIT system share broad motifs involving light, heat, cold and energy conversion, but the currently bound sources specify different device architectures.
The Juri model and Standard Thermal share broad heat and energy-conversion language, but their currently bound technical chains differ.
Any person associated with KIT or Standard Thermal had access to or knowledge of the bound Juri artifacts before developing the external systems.
